title: Vision Material Presentation v1
description: The metal/stone presentation choice actually in effect. Metal always follows the live JDL selection (see docs/bible/10-vision/244-visual-consistency-contract.md's MATERIAL_METADATA_CONSISTENT level) — this is never an independent override.

metal.description: Identical enum to shared/types/jewelry-definition.ts's MetalType — always mirrors JewelryDefinition.material.metal, never a separate Vision-only choice.

stonePresentationEnabled.description: True in Presentation mode (transmissive stone look), false in Technical mode (opaque reference look). Not independently toggleable by the user — derived entirely from viewMode.
